title: Reset system metrics from the Overall System Aveva API page
summary: On the AVEVA HMI page labeled “Overall System Aveva API”, use “Reset Metrics” (and optionally “Reset Tipper Stats”) to clear metrics so the next metrics retrieval reflects the current sort plan state. Metrics also reset automatically when a new sort plan is loaded.
when_to_use: Use when the system metrics shown on the “Overall System Aveva API” page need to be cleared/restarted so the next metrics retrieval reflects the current sort plan state. Metrics also reset automatically when a new sort plan is loaded.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the “Reset Metrics” (and optional “Reset Tipper Stats”) actions on the AVEVA HMI “Overall System Aveva API” page and verify the page reflects the reset state.
access_or_tools_needed: AVEVA HMI (Overall System Aveva API page)

system_preconditions: The “Overall System Aveva API” page is available in the AVEVA HMI.

visual_references.description: Frame showing the “Overall System Aveva API page” with “Reset Metrics” and “Reset Tipper Stats” controls and related links (e.g., “Get metrics”).

steps.title: Open the AVEVA HMI “Overall System Aveva API” page
steps.purpose: Access the controls used to clear system metrics and (optionally) tipper metrics.
steps.instruction: Open the AVEVA HMI page labeled “Overall System Aveva API”.
steps.expected_result: The page displays the “Reset Metrics” control and the “Reset Tipper Stats” control.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Reset Metrics” and “Reset Tipper Stats” controls are visible on the “Overall System Aveva API” page.
steps.failure_condition: The “Reset Metrics” and/or “Reset Tipper Stats” controls are not visible or the page cannot be reached.

actions.label: Open Overall System Aveva API page
actions.exact_action: Open the AVEVA HMI page labeled “Overall System Aveva API”.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR shows “Overall System Aveva API page” with “Reset Metrics” and “Reset Tipper Stats”.

steps.title: Reset system metrics
steps.purpose: Clear the system metrics so the next metrics retrieval reflects the current sort plan state.
steps.expected_result: The metrics are reset on the page (the page indicates metrics are reset).
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking “Reset Metrics”, the page reflects that metrics have been reset.
steps.failure_condition: After clicking “Reset Metrics”, the metrics do not clear/restart as expected (metrics do not reset).
stop_or_escalate_if: If the reset controls do not appear to take effect (metrics do not clear/restart), stop and escalate to support for further investigation of the AVEVA/metrics behavior.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Reset Metrics… Metrics are reset when a new sort plan is loaded but can also be manually reset.”
OCR text includes: “Metrics are reset when a new sort plan is loaded but can also be manually reset.”

steps.title: Optionally reset tipper stats
steps.purpose: Clear tipper-related metrics as well, if needed.
steps.instruction: If needed, click “Reset Tipper Stats” on the same “Overall System Aveva API” page.
steps.expected_result: Tipper stats are reset on the page (tipper metrics are cleared so they can be re-collected).
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking “Reset Tipper Stats”, the page reflects that tipper stats/metrics have been reset.
steps.failure_condition: After clicking “Reset Tipper Stats”, tipper metrics do not clear/restart as expected.

actions.label: Click Reset Tipper Stats
actions.exact_action: If needed, click “Reset Tipper Stats” to reset tipper metrics as well.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the reset controls do not appear to take effect (metrics do not clear/restart), stop and escalate to support for further investigation of the AVEVA/metrics behavior.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Reset Tipper Stats… Metrics are reset when a new sort plan is loaded but can also be manually reset.”
OCR text includes “Reset Tipper Stats” and states tipper metrics are reset when a new sort plan is loaded but can also be manually reset.

steps.title: Proceed to the next metrics retrieval after reset
steps.purpose: Ensure the metrics view is repopulated after clearing metrics.
steps.instruction: Stop once the reset action has been performed and the page is ready for the next metrics retrieval (for example, use “Get metrics” if you need to repopulate the metrics view).
steps.expected_result: The page is ready for the next metrics retrieval action (e.g., “Get metrics” is available to repopulate the metrics view).
steps.healthy_condition: The “Get metrics” control is available on the “Overall System Aveva API” page after reset.
steps.failure_condition: The page does not become ready for the next metrics retrieval or “Get metrics” is not available.

actions.label: Verify page readiness
actions.exact_action: Stop when the reset action has been performed and the page is ready for the next metrics retrieval (e.g., after reset, use “Get metrics” if you need to repopulate the metrics view).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “get metrics gets all the system metrics, pops it up.”
OCR text shows “Get metrics” as a control/link on the “Overall System Aveva API page”.

success_criteria: After clicking “Reset Metrics”, the page indicates metrics are reset.
If “Reset Tipper Stats” is used, tipper metrics are reset/cleared so they can be re-collected.
The page is ready for the next metrics retrieval (e.g., “Get metrics” can be used to repopulate the metrics view).
healthy_conditions: “Reset Metrics” and “Reset Tipper Stats” controls are visible on the “Overall System Aveva API” page.
Metrics reset state is reflected on the page after the reset action.
“Get metrics” is available to repopulate the metrics view.
failure_conditions: Reset controls do not appear to take effect (metrics do not clear/restart).
Tipper stats do not clear/restart after using “Reset Tipper Stats” (if used).
escalation_guidance: If the reset controls do not appear to take effect (metrics do not clear/restart), stop and escalate to support for further investigation of the AVEVA/metrics behavior.
